metadata.subtitle: The Call-List Skill (Small Business)
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: when Claude produces a ranked call list, does it judge the leads itself, or run a fixed written procedure? Lands the carry-out that a skill runs the same steps on every request and only knows what's written in its file.

beats.narration_text: Someone assumes a ranked call list means Claude judged which leads matter most. It doesn't — the skill just processes a fixed set of steps written in a file. So does it judge, or process?

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'A ranked list means Claude judged my leads. Right?', hesitates on 'judged', corrects to 'processed', lands the real question

beats.narration_text: A skill is a folder Claude reads before it works. This one is call-list: a SKILL.md file, one file total. The SKILL.md contains the full instruction set — plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads it, then acts. The file is the program.
The pipeline is in the Steps section. Claude reads SKILL.md, executes each step in order, and returns the result. Linear — no branching unless a step says so.

production_viz.label: READ, EXECUTE, RETURN
production_viz.caption: linear — no branching unless a step says so

beats.narration_text: The skill answers only within what SKILL.md specifies: rank the five leads most worth calling today, pull talking points from email history, block time on the calendar, and draft the follow-up. Ask for something outside that written scope, and there's nothing there to answer with — same input, same steps, every run.

production_viz.label: ONLY WHAT THE FILE SAYS
production_viz.caption: same input, same steps, every run

beats.narration_text: A skill doesn't judge who's worth calling — it runs the same written steps on every list you hand it, and it only knows what's written in that file, nothing more.

props.quote: A skill doesn't judge who's worth calling — it runs the same written steps on every list you hand it, and it only knows what's written in that file, nothing more.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this into Claude: Rank my top five leads worth calling today from this week's email threads, then draft the follow-up messages. Read the call-list skill first and walk me through what you will do before you do it. Then check: did it name the steps it read from the file, or did it just start improvising? That's the actual test of whether it's running the skill.
